title: Refresh /lookups/slo (SLOs by AppCI)
description: Hourly refresh of /lookups/slo from the Gen3 SLO platform API. Writes one row per SLO name; the scorecard derives the AppCI from the first 3 characters of each name. Feeds the L2 SLOs Created check in ScorecardsPage and MaturityLeaderboard.

refresh_slo_lookup.name: refresh_slo_lookup
refresh_slo_lookup.description: Read all SLOs from the platform API, build one-row-per-name CSV, upload lookup table
